title: Vagus Nerve Immunohistochemistry for ChAT Detection
author: J. Ashley Ezzell
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.buxhnxj6
materials: Dehydrate, clear, and coverslip using DPX mountant.

steps.title: Bake Slides
steps.instruction: Bake slides containing paraffin-embedded vagus nerve sections overnight at 50°C, then cool overnight.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Hydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize the slides and hydrate them to distilled water using the following sequence:

steps.title: Perform Heat-Induced Epitope Retrieval (HIER)
steps.instruction: Perform HIER based on the sample species using the specified buffers and temperatures:

substeps.instruction: Human samples: 120°C for 30 s using buffer pH 6.0 (Thermo, TA-135-HBL)
Rat/pig samples: 95°C for 5 min followed by 90°C for 10 s using buffer pH 9.0 (BioCare, BD1000MM)

steps.title: Cool and Rinse
steps.instruction: Cool the slides and rinse to remove retrieval buffer.

substeps.instruction: Cool for 20 min at room temperature

steps.title: Block Endogenous Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Block endogenous peroxidase and rinse the slides.

substeps.instruction: Block with 3% H2O2 diluted in deionized water for 10 min

steps.title: Protein Blocking
steps.instruction: Block the slides using DAKO Protein Block (X0909) for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply goat anti-choline acetyltransferase (Millipore, AB144P) diluted in Thermo Antibody Diluent and incubate overnight at 4°C using the following concentrations:

steps.title: Rinse After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides to remove unbound primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)

steps.title: Apply Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply biotinylated SP-conjugated Affinipure donkey anti-goat IgG (H+L) (Jackson, 705-065-147) diluted 1:500 in Thermo Antibody Diluent and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Rinse After Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides to remove unbound secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)

steps.title: Apply ABC Elite
steps.instruction: Apply ABC Elite (Vector, PK-6100) at a concentration of 1:50 for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Rinse After ABC Elite
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides to remove unbound ABC Elite.

substeps.instruction: Rinse in Tris Tween buffer (2x 2 min)

steps.title: DAB Chromogen Development
steps.instruction: Apply DAB chromogen (Thermo, TA-125-QHDX) at room temperature for the specified duration based on sample type:

steps.title: Imaging
steps.instruction: Image samples at 20x using a Nikon Ti2 microscope with a DS-Ri2 color CMOS camera (Nikon Instruments Inc.), selecting the best of four slices based on quality (no tearing or fraying).
